title: Green radish coconut palm sticks
body_html:
Characteristics:
* 1. High Quality Materials: Totem pole is made of natural coconut moss fiber, which is safer for your plants. Help plants maintain water and nutrition and improve their growth.
* 2. Strong Support: Strong and sharp wooden poles make the pillars easy to insert into the ground, providing strong support for plant expansion. The rope wrapped around the post firmly fixes the foam on the coconut shell and can be used for a long time.
* 3. Widely Used: The coconut cane totem pole is an ideal holder for various indoor climbing plants. Very suitable for climbing plants and vines.
* 4. The height of each coconut stick is 17.7 inches. There is a PVC pipe in each coconut shell, and a pillar can be inserted into another pillar.

Description:
Climbing poles can be used for coconut sticks, plant climbing frames, flower frames, coconut moss sticks (for plant frame expansion), climbing plants indoor or vines.
